baselineIdentity.integrity: CRC, paths, all manifest sizes and SHA-256 PASS

versionDecision: Compatible experience preview, truthful capped progression and reward messages; product minor release. No persistent fields, schema, save keys, formulas, prices, RNG or content IDs changed.
mainChanges: memory_archive and starlibrary.study show exact nominal, accepted and discarded XP before payment and in newly resolved capped outcomes.
Level HUD distinguishes next-level progress, pending imported XP conversion and capped saved-XP capacity; progress width is bounded.
Upgrade logs show actual 2/1/0 talent points and lost remainder; combat overflow receives an accurate log.
Existing exchange confirmation shares the temporary XP quote, including maximum-length equipment names and dual-zero rewards.
regressionGuards: Original 52 test modules, two fixtures and eight font/license files are byte-identical.
Save schema5, complete expected snapshots and unknown fields, Web Locks, primary/mirror/legacy ordering and the 5MB new-write limit remain.
XP capacity is applied before existing XP is consumed for levels. Max level is 1000000, XP balance cap100000000, unspent-point cap2000000.
Zero-credit voluntary payment/exchange remains possible after explicit confirmation. Registered prices stay authoritative; no automatic refund or new ban.
Six-room loop, manual up-to-six dice, one currency, five equipment slots and eight rarity gates remain; renderer/effects/motion and runtime images are unchanged.
compatibilityBoundary: option.experience is ephemeral. Existing arbitrary event.experience data is preserved. Historical resolved messages are not rewritten and no missing historical XP receipt is invented.

deepEconomy.normalization: Only the preserved audit script runId normalization; no log/XP/receipt fields removed.

fonts.decoder: Existing Node zlib Brotli fallback; no new dependency installed.

inventoryBatches.mapping: In this raw report baseline is HTTP5.10 and after is HTTP5.9; metrics here mapped by actual release.

limits: First batch shows a +142.7ms p50 and +103.6ms p95 regression for current. Reversing order yields +5.3ms p50 with lower p95/max for current. The large median difference is not stable across these batches; shared software timing cannot establish its cause.
Both batches and every slow sample remain. They are separately reported, not selected, replaced, pooled as one homogeneous latency claim, or described as balanced random order.
One window per frame cell; callback timings and stage metadata are not physical GPU FPS or an all-frame visual certification.
P2 software stalls and large-inventory latency remain open; this release contains no claimed performance optimization.

packaging.selfReferenceRule: Manifest excludes itself. Final ZIP bytes, decimal MB, SHA-256 and file count are external; internal candidate metadata identifies a separate preflight archive only.

candidate.label: candidate
candidate.note: This is an external gate receipt. An internal candidate receipt identifies only that separate preflight ZIP, never the final distributed ZIP.

packaging.finalGate: Distribute only after the final actual archive passes fresh extraction, CRC/path/manifest hashes, syntax, npm test and 45-resource HTTP; exact final receipt remains outside this same ZIP.

openRisks: P2: multi-second SwiftShader RAF stalls and missed full-stage observations; physical GPU/4K60 is not tested.

P2: large inventory and complete synchronous save/DOM latency. First batch p50 worsened142.7ms; reverse-order batch worsened5.3ms and tail direction reversed. No stable large causal regression or speedup is established.
P3: deep build/service opportunity costs need same-budget counterfactuals and human comprehension work.
P3: whole-game narrow viewport, actual phone/pen, screen reader, audio, Windows double-click, OS suspension and physical power loss remain untested.
Old resolved XP messages remain historical text; no retrospective receipt can be derived reliably.
nextRoundPriorities: Compare deep choices from the same saved encounter and equal budget.
Measure and reduce complete save/DOM tail latency while preserving all transactions.
Diagnose physical/software GPU stalls with controlled repeats.
Test actual-device input, accessibility, audio and launcher.
evidenceNotes: All main reported checks were newly executed this round; archives remain historical.
The independent first-draft loadSave wrapper mismatch caused six QA assertion errors; corrected to .state without changing product code or old tests.
An alleged missing-dialog screenshot was a display/reviewer false alarm: PNG and decoded RGBA are identical and the original image shows the complete dialog; no rerun or product edit was needed.
Fixed-policy simulations and synthetic cap fixtures are not human player samples.
